repository: The repository has an AGENTS.md that every agent run reads, documentation pages in docs/, skills in .agents/skills/, memory files in .agents/memory/, a permission policy that allows, asks for or denies shell commands by their leading words (it cannot restrict file edits), and a CI check on every pull request. The person working with the agent is one member of a team.

facts.text: While debugging, the run found the staging database password, and the person said to use it for local tests.
facts.reason: A secret.

facts.text: The person said they joined the team last week and have not worked with Kotlin before.
facts.reason: About a person.

facts.text: The run finished two of the four steps of a refactor; renaming OrderService is left for tomorrow.
facts.reason: What a run did and what is left.

facts.text: The person corrected the run: they want explanations as bullet lists, not paragraphs. Nobody else on the team has said so.
facts.reason: One person's preference.

facts.text: The run learned that the HTTP handlers are in src/api/handlers/, one file per route, as the directory listing shows to anyone who opens it.
facts.reason: A run on the task sees it by listing the directory it changes.

facts.text: The run tried `git push origin main`; the permission policy refused it, as it refuses every `git push`.
facts.reason: Already enforced by the policy; nothing to add.

facts.text: A change is done only when `./gradlew check` passes. AGENTS.md does not say so, and a run stopped after the code compiled.
facts.reason: Every task needs it.

facts.text: To release, a run had to bump the version in three files, tag the commit and run scripts/publish, in that order. The team releases every two weeks.
facts.reason: A procedure agents repeat.

facts.text: The person explained that the public API returns dates in UTC because the mobile clients convert them; a run had changed an endpoint to return local times.
facts.reason: A decision about the product that people need too.

facts.text: Two branches each added a database migration numbered 0042; both passed their checks and the deploy applied only one. A new migration must take the next number after main's last one.
facts.reason: A check could catch it, but that check is more than the change that met the trap can add, so memory holds it until the check exists.

facts.text: `make db-reset` drops the local database without asking. A run used it to apply new migrations and lost an afternoon of hand-entered test data; `make db-migrate` applies migrations.
facts.reason: An ask entry for `make db-reset` in the policy enforces it, and this change can add one.

facts.text: `make db-migrate` exits 0 when the database is down and applies nothing. A run reported a migration as tested that had never run.
facts.reason: A false success signal in one area that no file shows and no small check catches.

facts.text: `make lint` also rewrites files in place, though its name suggests it only reports. A run used it to check one file and committed formatting changes to 40 unrelated files.
facts.reason: A command that looks right and is not; the policy cannot stop it without stopping linting.

facts.text: Adding a field to proto/order.proto also needs clients/ts/order.ts regenerated with `make gen-ts`. A run's backend tests passed, and the web client broke in staging.
facts.reason: Files that must change together with nothing pointing between them; a CI check for stale generated code is more than this change can add.

facts.text: A run fixed a typo in src/generated/api.ts. The next build regenerated the file from openapi.yaml and the fix vanished. The generated file has no header saying so.
facts.reason: A file something else writes; the policy cannot restrict edits.

facts.text: scripts/sync-fixtures prints 'done' and exits 0 when the fixture server is unreachable, and copies nothing. A run's tests then passed against month-old fixtures.
facts.reason: A success signal that is false.

facts.text: A run set `timeout = 30` in config/local.toml, and the service still timed out after 10 seconds: config/env.toml loads after it and overrides the value.
facts.reason: A setting another file overrides.

facts.text: The permission policy denies `git push`, and a run pushed with `git -C . push`, which the rule does not match.
facts.reason: A guard narrower than it reads; this change can add the missing policy entry.

facts.text: OrderIntegrationTest fails about one run in five with a timeout, on main too, and passes when rerun. A run spent an hour debugging its own change because of it.
facts.reason: A check that looks right and is not, in one area; it leaves memory when the test is fixed. Contested: tracker is defensible.

facts.text: For local work, `make db-migrate` must be run as `make db-migrate ENV=test`; without it, it targets the development database the team shares. The Makefile sets ENV=dev by default, in a variable 200 lines above the target.
facts.reason: A command that looks right and is not; the default is in the Makefile, but not where a run on the task reads. Contested: nowhere_already_shown is defensible.

facts.text: A run took 20 minutes to find that payment retries live in billing/jobs/retry_worker.py; the payments/ directory suggested they were elsewhere. Nothing went wrong.
facts.reason: Slow, not wrong: a line under Where things go in AGENTS.md.

facts.text: To find which service owns an endpoint, a run searched the whole repository three times, about 200,000 tokens. tools/owner <path> answers it in one call. Nothing went wrong.
facts.reason: Slow, not wrong: a costly routine becomes a skill.

facts.text: Bugs for this repository are tracked in the Jira project PAY, not in GitHub issues; a run opened a GitHub issue.
facts.reason: No row fits: a pointer outside the repository. The report asks where the team keeps it.

facts.text: The team freezes releases from December 15 to January 5.
facts.reason: No row fits: a date about the team's schedule. The report asks where the team keeps it.
